mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.1%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 4.0% signals labor market tightening, boosting corporate hiring and consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST are above their 50th percentile, or interaction term coefficient has p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) triggers aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline below 100.0 (index base 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% month-over-month) supports wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts decline below 1600.0 thousand units signals weakening residential construction, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is below 1600.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 0.5% indicate active monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or interaction term coefficient has p-value > 0.05.
